tools.name: get_post_analytics
tools.description: Get LinkedIn performance for one published ContentIn post: impressions, members reached, likes, comments, shares, and a derived engagement rate. IMPORTANT: metrics are fetched on a schedule and only for posts published through a connected LinkedIn account, so a post can legitimately have no numbers

Pass post_id (a ContentIn post id from list_posts) to repurpose one of their own posts — the current text is read from ContentIn, so you do not need to have seen it. tools.name: generate_ideas
tools.description: Generate fresh LinkedIn post ideas for a COLD request — the user wants options but has NOT given you material of their own ('what should I post about this week?', 'ideas for [topic]'). Ideas are grounded in the user's content pillars and their substance bank, so they are theirs rather than generic.

tools.description: Save a piece of the user's first-party substance — a story, an opinion, a data point, or a framework — into their ContentIn content bank, filed under one of their content pillars. TWO-STEP AND MANDATORY: call it first WITHOUT confirm_token to get back the exact text that would go out and a confirm_token; show that exact text to the user in full, ask them to confirm i

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "publish_post" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post_analytics, repurpose_post, schedule_post, publish_post · Private data: schedule_post, publish_post · Public sink: list_posts, get_post_analytics, write_post_in_my_voice, repurpose_post, generate_ideas, schedule_post, publish_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post_analytics, repurpose_post, schedule_post, publish_post · Private data: schedule_post, publish_post · Public sink: list_posts, get_post_analytics, write_post_in_my_voice, repurpose_post, generate_ideas, schedule_post, publish_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
